detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic cinematic fantasy sequence in a cold desaturated palette with detailed snow, ice, firelight, cloth motion, and atmospheric depth. The scene uses six connected shots with motivated cuts and continuous action continuity. Preserve both reference subjects' faces, costumes, body proportions, and spatial identities despite the more complex motion. The fortress remains the same location throughout. Background animation includes wind-driven snow, slowly moving banners, flickering braziers, drifting frost particles, subtle ice reflections, and distant atmospheric haze; do not add extra people, creatures, or a new location.
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, begin with a wide establishing view of the frozen fortress courtyard from <Subject 3>. The woman from <Subject 1> stands on screen-left and the hero from <Subject 2> stands on screen-right, facing each other. The camera makes a slow forward dolly while snow crosses the frame, banners move in the wind, and the braziers flicker. Keep both characters clearly recognizable and their relative positions stable.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, cut to a medium two-shot and then a restrained lateral arc around the pair. The woman turns slightly toward the hero and raises one hand; her white hair and black cloak respond to a strengthening icy wind. Frost gathers around her hand and small ice crystals spiral outward without covering her face or changing her armor. The hero remains grounded and watches her, his red cape moving naturally.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, move into an over-the-shoulder view from behind the hero toward the woman, then push slowly toward her face. She completes the controlled ice gesture, sending a visible but contained wave of frost across the courtyard. Snow and frost particles travel through the background, the stone arches remain fixed, and the firelight continues flickering. Preserve the woman's facial identity and pointed ears.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, cut to a medium close-up of the hero and perform a slow semicircular camera move as he takes one deliberate step forward. His blue suit, gold-trimmed mask, and red cape remain unchanged. Wind pushes the cape and loose snow past him. He raises one hand defensively while keeping his body proportions and identity stable; do not create extra limbs or duplicate hands.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.500, alternate between a close-up of the hero and a balanced two-shot as a restrained blue-white energy begins glowing in his eyes. The glow gradually intensifies, illuminating nearby snow and the edge of his mask without washing out his face. The woman remains visible in the background on screen-left, her cloak and hair still moving in the icy wind. The camera slowly pulls backward, revealing the animated braziers, banners, snow, and ice reflections across the fortress courtyard.
[Shot 6] At 00:16.800, complete the final exchange with a smooth pullback into a wide two-shot. The hero's blue-white eye glow reaches its strongest controlled intensity, a low energy vibration disturbs nearby frost, and the woman lowers her hand as the swirling ice settles. Both characters remain in their established positions, facing each other inside the same frozen fortress. End at 00:20.000 with the courtyard, arches, snow, braziers, banners, and both stable identities clearly visible. The external NativeAudioLock track is the sole source of Chinese dialogue and speech timing. Keep all actions physically coherent, with no subtitles, readable text, logos, watermarks, extra people, extra creatures, extra limbs, costume changes, identity drift, or location change.
